title: Law360 spotlights Burford-backed Kindleworth’s US expansion amid boutique boom
summary: Law360 reports that amid a wave of major law firm mergers, Burford-backed Kindleworth is working with high-billing partners to launch specialist boutiques, with co-founder James Hacking saying “there’s never been a better time” to take that route. Learn more.
